faqs.q: How do I add the schema to my page?

faqs.a: FAQ rich results make your listing taller in search results and can lift click-through rates. They are not guaranteed — Google decides per page — but valid markup is the entry ticket.
faqs.q: Does FAQ schema improve my Google ranking?

faqs.a: Yes. Keep questions concise, write answers that fully answer the question, and make sure the same Q&A is visible on the page. Hidden-only content violates Google's guidelines.
faqs.q: Are there content rules for FAQ rich results?

faqs.a: You can, but it is not required. JSON-LD in the page source works without any visible accordion, as long as the questions and answers also appear in the visible page content.
faqs.q: Do I need a visible FAQ accordion too?

howTo: Click Add question for each FAQ entry on your page.
Type the question exactly as visitors would ask it.
Write the answer in one or two clear sentences.
Copy the generated JSON-LD with the copy button.
Paste it into a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag on your page.
keyFacts: FAQPage is a schema.org type that describes a list of questions and answers.
JSON-LD is Google's recommended format for structured data.
Each entry needs @type Question with a name and an acceptedAnswer.
The acceptedAnswer holds @type Answer with the answer text.
Google's Rich Results Test validates the markup before you publish.

limitations: Schema markup does not guarantee rich results — Google decides per page.
Questions and answers must also be visible on the page; hidden-only content is against guidelines.
Incomplete pairs are skipped, so proofread before publishing.
Very long answers may be truncated in search results.
